key_insight: RefAlign learns to align the reference-image representation into the diffusion model’s latent space so the generator can use a single, unified representation — improving fidelity and controllability in reference-to-video synthesis with a simpler pipeline.
problem_solved: Current R2V methods feed separate high-level or cross-modal features alongside VAE latents into the diffusion Transformer, causing architectural complexity, misalignment between modalities, and suboptimal preservation of reference appearance and temporal consistency.
method: Representation alignment module: project and align the reference VAE latent into the DiT-compatible latent space so the diffusion model consumes a unified reference representation.
Alignment objectives: train with reconstruction/identity-preservation and contrastive/consistency losses to keep appearance and pose while making representations diffusion-friendly.
Integrated diffusion generation: condition the video diffusion transformer on text prompts plus the aligned reference latent for temporally coherent, controllable video synthesis.
impact: RefAlign simplifies R2V pipelines while improving visual fidelity and temporal consistency, making controllable reference-conditioned video generation more reliable and easier to integrate into real-world applications like personalized advertising and virtual try-on.
